name: University of Huddersfield

programs.title: Art, Media & Architecture
programs.summary: Delve into the International Foundation Year in Art, Media and Architecture and gain the skills and knowledge needed for a wide range of related undergraduate degrees such as in art, journalism or media.

programs.title: Business, Management & Law
programs.summary: Venture into business, management and law with a pathway programme at the University of Huddersfield International Study Centre.

programs.title: Engineering, Computing & Science
programs.summary: Boost your scientific and engineering knowledge with a pathway programme at the University of Huddersfield International Study Centre.

programs.title: Human Science and Humanities
programs.summary: Prepare for a rewarding career in human science and humanities. Choose from two subject routes in human science or education and professional development to enhance the knowledge and skills needed for degrees in psychology, criminology and education.

programs.title: Computing
programs.summary: Develop your skills and knowledge within the world of computing and prepare to study a postgraduate degree at the University of Huddersfield with this Pre-Master's programme.

programs.title: Health Science
programs.summary: Prepare for a successful career in health science at University of Huddersfield International Study Centre. Enhance your knowledge in biology, pure maths, and social sciences, and develop the skills needed for degrees in nursing, physiotherapy and nutrition.

programs.title: Business, Management & Marketing
programs.summary: Expand your business knowledge with this International Year One pathway programme. You will gain the vital skills and knowledge needed to study a business related degree at the University of Huddersfield.

programs.title: Engineering & Computer Science
programs.summary: The International Year One in Computing is your route to a variety of engineering and computer science degrees at the University of Huddersfield. Choose from a range of pathways including mechanical and electrical engineering.

programs.title: Business, Management & Marketing
programs.summary: Want to expand your business, management and marketing knowledge? Choose this Pre-Master’s pathway programme to unlock your potential and prepare for a postgraduate degree at the University of Huddersfield.

description: Huddersfield is a historic market town close to beautiful countryside and exciting big cities. Home to 20,000 students, the town has a thriving student community.
